title: About Form 1096, Annual Summary and Transmittal of U.S. Information Returns

passages.question: Is a Form 1096 needed?
passages.excerpt: Use Form 1096 to transmit paper Forms 1097, 1098, 1099, 3921, 3922, 5498, and W-2G to the Internal Revenue Service. Do not use this form to transmit electronically.
